---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: config
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:         "Configuration"
  name:          ""
  desc:          ""
  class:         "config"
  image_file:    NULL
  logos:         NULL
  config_df:     NULL
  discount_df:   NULL
  horizon_plot:  NULL
  intervals_df:  NULL
  calendar_plot: NULL
  frames_df:     NULL
  geo_map:       NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r en-setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L, ...)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt, ...)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
```

```{r en-css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r en-logo, results='asis'}
if (length(params$logos) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$logos, frac_total = 0.9, output = fmt)
}
```

```{r en-header, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_header(params$name, params$desc,
                        image_file = params$image_file, output = fmt)
```

## Settings

```{r en-config, results='asis'}
tbl(params$config_df)
```

```{r en-discount, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$discount_df)}
tbl(params$discount_df, caption = "Discount rates (wacc / sdr)")
```

```{r en-horizon, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$horizon_plot) || !is.null(params$intervals_df)}
energyRt::report_sec("Horizon", output = fmt)
if (!is.null(params$horizon_plot)) {
  emit_img(energyRt::report_plot_png(params$horizon_plot, 7, 2.4), 1)
}
tbl(params$intervals_df, max_rows = 20)
```

```{r en-calendar, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$calendar_plot) || !is.null(params$frames_df)}
energyRt::report_sec("Calendar", output = fmt)
if (!is.null(params$calendar_plot)) {
  emit_img(energyRt::report_plot_png(params$calendar_plot, 7, 3.4), 1)
}
tbl(params$frames_df, caption = "Timeslices per timeframe")
```

```{r en-geo, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$geo_map)}
energyRt::report_sec("Geography", output = fmt)
emit_img(energyRt::report_plot_png(params$geo_map, 6.5, 4.5), 0.9)
```
